info.name: Card Dispute POC API
info.description:
Increment 1 and 2 endpoints of the Card Dispute POC backend (synthetic data only).

Auth: HTTP Basic with the seeded demo users (customer001..customer100 and analyst001, password `demo`). The collection uses customer001 by default; folders override it where needed.

Transaction ids follow the seed formula `d0020000-0000-4000-8000-{pairIndex*10 + side}` (12 digits), where side 1 is the disputed charge and side 2 its suspected duplicate. For customer001, pair N uses scenario N-1 of `003-Demo-seed.sql`.

The Camunda process runs synchronously on submit: SUPPORTED / NOT_SUPPORTED cases come back resolved, MANUAL_REVIEW cases come back AWAITING_ANALYST with an open analyst task (folder 06 decides them). If nobody decides within the review deadline (default PT5M, `CARD_DISPUTE_MANUAL_REVIEW_TIMEOUT`), the dispute becomes TIMEOUT_REVIEW_REQUIRED and the task stays open (folder 07).

Every request gets a random `X-Correlation-Id` header (collection pre-request script).

Run folders 00-06 in order on a fresh seed, then run folder 07 after the review deadline has passed. Re-running '02 - Submit scenarios' returns 409 for the MANUAL_REVIEW cases that are still open.
